questions.question: TCP 3-way handshake'ni socket darajasida (`listen()`, `accept()`, `connect()`) tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: Server socket yaratadi, bind(), listen() — SYN queue (tcp_max_syn_backlog) va accept queue (somaxconn bilan cheklangan backlog) yaratiladi.

questions.question: TCP accept queue overflow nima va qanday aniqlanadi?
questions.explanation: Ilova accept() ni sekin chaqirsa accept queue to'ladi va kernel client'ning yakuniy ACK larini jimgina tashlaydi (client timeout/retry ko'radi).

questions.question: `epoll`, `select` va `poll` farqi.
questions.explanation: select/poll: har chaqiruvda barcha descriptor'larni chiziqli tekshiradi (O(N)); select 1024 FD bilan cheklangan.

questions.question: Linux'da zero-copy (`sendfile()` / `splice()`) nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel va user space orasida CPU nusxalashni yo'qotadi: sendfile() ma'lumotni page cache'dan socket buffer'ga kernel ichida uzatadi — kam CPU bilan yuqori throughput (statik fayl serverlari, Kafka).

questions.question: Transparent Huge Pages (THP) nima va nega Redis/MongoDB uchun o'chiriladi?
questions.explanation: THP 4KB o'rniga 2MB page ajratib TLB miss'larni kamaytiradi. Lekin tasodifiy kichik kirishli DB'larda allokatsiya/compaction latency sakrashlari va fork + CoW'da xotira kuchayishi bo'ladi. O'chirish: echo never > /sys...

questions.question: Dirty memory (`vm.dirty_ratio` va `vm.dirty_background_ratio`) nima?
questions.explanation: Page cache'da o'zgartirilgan, lekin diskka hali yozilmagan sahifalar:

questions.question: Kernel ring buffer (`dmesg`) nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel xotirasidagi qat'iy o'lchamli aylanma buffer: driver xabarlari, hardware ogohlantirishlari, OOM killer, segfault'lar.

questions.question: Linux tizimlarida eBPF nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel ichidagi virtual mashina: verifier tekshirgan sandbox bytecode'ni tracepoint, kprobe va socket qatlamlarida kernel source'ini o'zgartirmasdan va beqaror modul yuklamasdan bajaradi (bcc, bpftrace).

questions.question: `perf` nima?
questions.explanation: Rasmiy Linux profiler: hardware counter'lar, CPU sikllari, cache miss'lar va kernel tracepoint'larini tahlil qiladi; flame graph uchun (perf record -g, perf top).

questions.question: Ssenariy: 8 yadroli serverda load average 45.0, lekin CPU 15%. Bottleneck nima va qanday tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: Sabab: process'lar D holatida — sekin disk I/O yoki osilib qolgan NFS mount'ni kutmoqda (load average D'ni ham sanaydi).

questions.question: Ssenariy: kritik process "Too many open files" (`EMFILE`) bilan yiqildi. Butunlay qanday tuzatasiz?
questions.explanation: Process limitlari: cat /proc/<PID>/limits; ochiq FD soni: ls /proc/<PID>/fd | wc -l.

questions.question: Ssenariy: o'chirilgan log fayl `df -h` da hali ham 100GB joy egallayapti. Nega va joyni darhol qanday qaytarasiz?
questions.explanation: Nega: ishlab turgan process (Java/Nginx) o'chirilgan fayl inode'iga ochiq FD ushlab turibdi; barcha FD'lar yopilmaguncha block'lar bo'shatilmaydi.

questions.question: Ssenariy: ko'p thread'li ilovada xotira fragmentatsiyasi va allokatsiya latency'si. glibc malloc'ni `jemalloc`/`tcmalloc` bilan qanday almashtirasiz?

questions.question: Ssenariy: xotira tugab server SSH'da javob bermayapti. Magic SysRq'ni qanday ishlatasiz?
questions.explanation: Hardware yoki cloud serial console orqali kernel'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri buyruq (Alt+SysRq+<key> yoki echo <key> > /proc/sysrq-trigger):

questions.question: NUMA va NUMA balancing nima?
questions.explanation: Ko'p socket'li serverda har CPU socket'ning o'z lokal xotirasi bor; boshqa socket xotirasiga kirish sekinroq. numactl --interleave=all yoki process'ni lokal node'ga bog'lash (numactl --cpunodebind=0 --membind=0) bilan...

questions.question: cgroup v2 unified hierarchy (`/sys/fs/cgroup`) nima?
questions.explanation: v1 ning alohida controller'lari o'rniga yagona process daraxti: aniq memory writeback hisobi, PSI va rootless delegatsiya.

questions.question: Pressure Stall Information (PSI) nima?
questions.explanation: CPU, xotira va I/O bo'yicha resurs tanqisligini o'lchovchi kernel metrikasi (/proc/pressure/memory) — task'lar resurs kutib to'xtab qolgan vaqt foizi. Utilization'dan ko'ra aniqroq to'yinish signali.

questions.question: Linux capabilities (`getpcaps`, `setcap`) nima?
questions.explanation: Executable'larga nozik huquqlarni ko'rish va berish (setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' /usr/bin/node — root'siz 80-portni ochish).

questions.question: SELinux permissive va enforcing farqi.
questions.explanation: Enforcing: kirishni bloklaydi va log qiladi.

questions.question: Network interface bonding (LACP / mode 4) nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta fizik interfeysni bitta virtual interfeysga birlashtirish — bandwidth va avtomatik failover (IEEE 802.3ad, switch ham qo'llashi kerak).

questions.question: VLAN tagging (802.1Q) nima?
questions.explanation: Sub-interfeys (eth0.100) yaratib, chiquvchi Ethernet frame'larga 12-bitli VLAN ID qo'yish.

questions.question: Generic Segmentation Offload (GSO) nima?
questions.explanation: Paketni segmentlarga bo'lishni driver darajasigacha kechiktirish — CPU yuki kamayadi (TSO bilan NIC'ga ham).

questions.question: LRO / GRO nima?
questions.explanation: Ketma-ket kiruvchi TCP paketlarini TCP/IP stack'ka uzatishdan oldin bitta katta buffer'ga yig'ish — CPU tejaladi (LRO routing/forwarding'da muammo beradi, GRO xavfsizroq).

questions.question: Kernel modulni blacklist qilish nima?
questions.explanation: /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist.conf orqali ma'lum driver'larni (nouveau, floppy) boot'da avtomatik yuklanishdan to'xtatish (initramfs'ni qayta yaratish kerak bo'lishi mumkin).

questions.question: `lsmod` va `modprobe` nima?
questions.explanation: lsmod: yuklangan kernel modullari.

questions.question: `dkms` nima?
questions.explanation: Yangi kernel o'rnatilganda third-party modullarni (NVIDIA, ZFS) avtomatik qayta compile qiladi.

questions.question: Kernel panic va kdump nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel panic — tiklab bo'lmaydigan fatal xato. kdump kexec bilan zaxira kernel'ni ishga tushirib, yiqilgan kernel xotirasini (vmcore) tahlil uchun diskka yozadi (crash tool bilan).

questions.question: Swap partition va swap file farqi.
questions.explanation: Partition — maxsus xom bo'lim; swap file — mavjud FS'dagi oldindan ajratilgan fayl (fallocate -l 4G /swapfile; chmod 600; mkswap; swapon). Zamonaviy kernel'larda unumdorlik deyarli bir xil, fayl moslashuvchanroq (Btrf...

questions.question: `taskset` bilan CPU pinning (affinity) nima?
questions.explanation: Process'ni faqat belgilangan yadrolarda bajarish (taskset -c 0,1 ./app) — L1/L2 cache hit'larini oshirish va shovqinli qo'shnilardan ajratish.

questions.question: `chrt` nima?
questions.explanation: Latency'ga kritik process'lar uchun real-time scheduling policy (SCHED_FIFO, SCHED_RR) va prioritet o'rnatadi (noto'g'ri ishlatilsa tizimni muzlatishi mumkin).

questions.question: CFS bandwidth control (`cpu.cfs_quota_us` / v2'da `cpu.max`) nima?
questions.explanation: Kvota davri (odatda 100 000 µs) bo'yicha container'ga qat'iy CPU limitini majburlovchi cgroup mexanizmi.

questions.question: VM'larda memory ballooning nima?
questions.explanation: Guest OS ichidagi hypervisor driver'i "shishib" bo'sh VM'lardan fizik RAM'ni hypervisor'ga qaytaradi.

questions.question: `blkdiscard` / `fstrim` (SSD TRIM) nima?
questions.explanation: SSD controller'ga qaysi block'lar endi ishlatilmayotganini bildiradi — yozish unumdorligi saqlanadi (fstrim.timer haftalik).

questions.question: Linux'da RAID 0, 1, 5, 10 (`mdadm`) farqi.
questions.explanation: RAID 0: striping — tez, nosozlikka chidamlilik yo'q.

questions.question: ZFS zpool va dataset farqi.
questions.explanation: Zpool: xom disklarni RAID-Z bilan birlashtirgan storage pool.

questions.question: Epoll starvation nima?
questions.explanation: Epoll worker loop bitta socket'dagi katta I/O'ni qayta ishlab qolib, boshqa faol socket'larni "och" qoldirishi — har iteratsiyada ishni cheklash (fairness) bilan oldi olinadi.

questions.question: Socket buffer autotuning nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel TCP receive/send buffer'larini hisoblangan Bandwidth-Delay Product (BDP) ga ko'ra dinamik moslaydi (tcp_rmem/tcp_wmem chegaralarida).

questions.question: Enterprise Linux hardening checklist qanday?
questions.explanation: SSH'da root login va parol autentifikatsiyasini o'chirish (faqat kalit).
